purpose: Bind PR #775 release-provenance recovery, truth-governance hardening, and security evidence freshness to current path-specific documentation. This receipt records documentation coverage only; it cannot retroactively convert direct-main history into reviewed PR provenance, resolve semantic review findings, renew stale evidence, atomically consume one-shot authority, grant model authority, authorize merge or deploy, mutate providers, or prove production runtime state.

claims: .github/workflows/main-release-provenance.yml must run the full-history historical-ratification verifier against the exact candidate and cannot relabel historical direct-main commits as original pull-request merges or grant merge or deploy authority.

scripts/verify-main-release-historical-ratification.mjs must fail closed unless each registered incident matches its exact anchor tree, incident-tip tree, ordered first-parent sequence, affected-file set, and candidate ancestry.
scripts/pr-continuity.mjs must re-read the pull request, root branch tip, and actual base branch tip immediately before mutation and must block instead of patching when any observed identity moved.

scripts/verify-documentation-truth.mjs must classify release-provenance, generic truth, interop, approval, PR-continuity, and security-evidence sources as truth-sensitive so their changes cannot pass Documentation Truth without current path-bound documentation.

src/truth/truth.ts must require explicitly linked, source-matched authoritative evidence with a valid non-future observation time and applicable freshness, target, and integrity bindings before a verified claim can render green.

src/lib/agentInterop.ts must require the exact source project-state packet for instruction validation, revalidate that packet at consumption time, and reject future-dated or expired source observations.

src/approvals/approval.ts must reject non-JSON or sparse canonical payload structures, require explicit replay-state input, and cannot claim that snapshot validation itself atomically consumes one-shot authority.

src/security/cryptographicInventory.ts must pin every static cryptographic observation to the exact inspected source revision and must classify it STALE after its freshness lease expires instead of allowing response generation to renew it.

src/security/securityPosture.ts must derive the founder-facing cryptographic inventory from the freshness-aware snapshot and cannot promote stale static source evidence back to OBSERVED or PROVIDER_MANAGED state.

public/control-room/security.js must visibly render cryptographic observation state, pinned source revision, observation and expiry lease, stale reason, and revalidation requirement without implying that a fresh page render renews evidence.

security/portfolio-worker-security.json must bind declaredFromMainSha to the exact reviewed source baseline while preserving unobserved provider and runtime fields as UNVERIFIED or unknown; refreshing source identity cannot manufacture production security proof.
